name: Permanent Stay (stalni boravak)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having held refugee status in Croatia for at least 10 years.

requirement_groups.name: Family member of a Croatian citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being a close family member of a Croatian citizen (the source does not state a separate residence-duration test for this category).
Requires recognised membership of the Croatian diaspora (the source does not state a separate residence-duration test for this category).
Requires having been born in Croatia (to parents lawfully resident there).

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying category (refugee record, family tie, diaspora recognition, or birth record)

sources.title: Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Republike Hrvatske (mup.gov.hr) -- Long-Term Residence and Permanent stay

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Croatia's initial build. This is Croatia's own domestic 'permanent stay' (stalni boravak) status, distinct from the EU-directive 'long-term residence' status (see hr_long_term_residence) which most foreign residents use instead -- the source page describes permanent stay as available for a narrower set of categories: ordinary long-standing temporary stay, family members of Croatian citizens, Croatian diaspora, refugees, and children born in Croatia. HONEST GAP, DELIBERATE MODELLING CHOICE: the source states permanent stay for general (non-refugee) categories takes 'typically three to four years of uninterrupted temporary stay depending on circumstances' but does NOT break out which exact figure applies to which category -- rather than invent a number for the family/diaspora/born-in-Croatia groups, those three groups are modelled WITHOUT a months_in_country test, using only the qualifying-relationship/status fact itself as the hard requirement (which the source does support without a stated duration for these specific categories). Only the refugee group has a duration figure, because the source states it explicitly (10 years). This likely understates real difficulty for the family/diaspora/born groups if an unstated duration test does in fact apply -- flagged, not silently resolved. No Croatian-language requirement applies to this status, unlike hr_long_term_residence, per the same source page.
